summary: Scoped to three frontend surfaces per file-tree.md's 161-file inventory: the iOS SwiftUI app (FellowScript/FellowScript/, 46 files, Xcode project confirmed), the React/Vite SPA (frontend/src/, 94 files), and the actively-maintained legacy static tree (frontend/{account,reader,signin}.html + css/ + js/, 21 files) served in parallel by nginx. Backend api/ and frontend/index.html remain out of scope. All four relevant preference-tracker modules (Proposed Architecture/Implementation, UI/UX Design, Security Posture, Configuration Philosophy) are Complete in ~/Downloads/ai_preference_survey_tracker.md and their established answers are cited in compliance-plan.md's Preference profile section.
